modules.name: @nit/cli
modules.description: The deterministic core: supervisor state machine, archetype and routing resolvers, JSON schemas, and the nit CLI. Everything ADR-0004 says must be tested code rather than prose.

modules.name: @nit/skills
modules.description: The agent-facing definitions: step and command skills, agent personas, and the validation hooks. Skills invoke the CLI; the CLI never reads a skill.

modules.name: @nit/workspace
modules.description: Project business state — PRD, phases, tasks, decisions, retrospectives. Consumed by the skills and the CLI; depends on neither (ADR-0006).
